source: Haz un juego 3d de una ciudad enorme y tu apretás un botón y con ese botón te puedes columpiar libremente como spiderman

image_prompt.text: A few standout towers rising above the skyline so a swinging player always knows where they are
Streets and avenues running the grid below, for players who drop to the ground
Rooftop vantage points composed for the view back across the city
An enormous city of densely packed skyscrapers and mid-rises, spaced so a player can swing from one to the next
Rooftops, ledges, and balconies that give the swing something to attach to

notes: No genre - a city you move through freely is a place, not a game type in the index. Traversal sandbox has no home.
Play-space is volumetric: the game happens in the air between buildings, so CHECK whether the play volume self-occludes from one top-down view. Stacked verticality costs P2.
Building spacing and height are the entire design constraint here and the handoff has no way to state a swing range.

open_questions.ask: Grounded modern city, or something more stylized and comic-book?
Is swinging around the whole game, or is there something to do in the city?
How far should the city run before it ends - and what stops the player at the edge?

answers.ask: Grounded modern city, or something more stylized and comic-book?
answers.answer: Una ciudad moderna realista y sencilla, para que el balanceo libre sea el centro del juego.

answers.ask: Is swinging around the whole game, or is there something to do in the city?
answers.answer: El juego consiste en recorrer la ciudad y columpiarse libremente; no hacen falta misiones ni objetivos adicionales.

answers.ask: How far should the city run before it ends - and what stops the player at the edge?
answers.answer: Haz una ciudad grande pero manejable, de varios bloques y rascacielos, con límites invisibles en el borde del mapa para que el jugador no salga.
